obligations.title: Provide the written Sub-processor list on the Effective Date and on request.
Give the Customer 30 days' prior written notice of any Sub-processor addition or replacement.
Notify the Customer of a Personal Data Breach within 48 hours of becoming aware of it.
obligations.clause_heading: Section 5. Security and Personal Data Breach

obligations.title: Supplement the breach notice as further information becomes available.
obligations.clause_heading: Section 5. Security and Personal Data Breach

obligations.title: Contain and remediate Personal Data Breaches and cooperate on regulator and individual notifications.
obligations.clause_heading: Section 5. Security and Personal Data Breach

obligations.title: Implement and maintain appropriate technical and organizational security measures.
obligations.clause_heading: Section 5. Security and Personal Data Breach

obligations.title: Ensure personnel handling Personal Data are bound by confidentiality and trained.
Promptly notify the Customer if an instruction infringes data protection law.
Promptly forward data subject requests received directly to the Customer.
obligations.clause_heading: Section 7. Assistance, Audit and Return of Data

obligations.title: Return or securely delete all Personal Data and certify deletion in writing on expiry, termination or Customer request.
